title: Cost Optimization & FinOps — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Automated Programmatic Budget Enforcement Flow: monthly spend threshold breached -> Pub/Sub notification -> Cloud Run execution -> sandbox project billing decoupling.
routing_rationale: Programmatic budget enforcement provides an automated safety net for sandbox and development environments, ensuring runaway experiments cannot drain corporate budgets.

nodes.label: Runaway GPU Training Job
nodes.detail: Intern launched unconstrained ML model training loop over the weekend.

nodes.label: Current Monthly Spend
nodes.detail: Exceeds 100% of allocated monthly sandbox development budget.

nodes.label: Cloud Function Cap Worker
nodes.detail: Iterates through sandbox project and cleanly shuts down all running VM instances.

nodes.label: Slack FinOps Alert
nodes.detail: Notifies developer and engineering manager of budget cap enforcement.

steps.title: Budget Breach Notification
steps.action: Cloud Billing publishes event to Pub/Sub within 15 minutes of budget breach.
steps.why_traversal: Enables proactive serverless intervention before runaway spend escalates.

steps.title: Safe Compute Halting
steps.action: Function stops running instances without deleting persistent disks, preserving code and data.
steps.why_traversal: Cuts variable compute burn to zero immediately while preventing developer data loss.

scenarios.label: Unlinking Billing Destroys Project Resources
scenarios.root_cause: Automation unlinked billing from project instead of stopping VMs; triggered Google 30-day resource deletion countdown.
scenarios.recovery: Never unlink billing in production; use targeted compute instance stopping for sandbox cost control.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
